info.title: AWS Evidence Lab owned retrieval and answer runs
info.description: Unreleased API contract. Cloud candidate is retrieval-only L/D/H/R with bounded SQS and durable work slots. Answer-budget opt-in exists locally but is disabled in cloud. JWT/owner authorization, no-store responses and quality metrics null. Cloud integration prepared and native/browser-tested, not deployed.

get.summary: Owner-authorized cloud retrieval capabilities and pinned corpus counts; no quota/model call

200.description: Available methods, maximum three per run, retrieval-only, answering disabled, quality_metrics null and English-encoder Vietnamese diagnostic limitation; Cache-Control no-store.

post.summary: Admit 1–3 L/D/H/R methods and return 202; cloud best-effort publish follows commit, watchdog recovers pending outbox. Cloud answers disabled.

202.description: Owner-authorized run projection; Cache-Control no-store. Answer runs include parent budget state. Quality metrics remain null.
